title: Immigrant Visa by Marriage (13A): requirements
content:
As listed by BetterGov.ph (from the Bureau of Immigration, updated 2025-06-06), the Immigrant Visa by Marriage (13A) is one of the immigrant visas: For foreign nationals married to Filipino citizens. Minimum requirements: Valid passport; Marriage certificate; Birth certificate of Filipino spouse; Police clearance from country of origin; Medical examination results.
Source: https://immigration.gov.ph/immigrant-visa-by-marriage-13a (listed 2025-06-06).
